name: session_search
description: Search one session's context (read-only): canonical messages (newest first; `reasoning_content` is searched too, and reported as 'reasoning' unless the body itself matches) plus text files under its assets directory (overflow archives, checkpoints). Returns snippets around matches. Use to check whether a topic, tool, or fact appears in another session before reading it in full. `max_results` is a single budget shared by canonical messages and asset files, and canonical matches are counted first — when it is exhausted, no further matches are printed, even though the asset files are still scanned.

session_id.description: Session id (from session_list), 1-128 ASCII letters, digits, '-' or '_'.

max_results.description: Maximum matches to return (default 20, max 100; 0 stops immediately).
